description: Why: misnamed error variants make log triage harder and can cause callers that match on error variant to take wrong action (e.g. reporting a read failure as a write failure to monitoring). What: fs_store.rs get_raw returns IpfsError::WriteFailed for read-path I/O errors. IpfsError::ReadFailed exists and is used by lmdb_store and rados_store for the same class of error. Consistent use of ReadFailed on the read path is necessary for correct variant-based error handling.
title: FsStore get_raw error returns IpfsError::WriteFailed on read errors
